procedure_name: Conversion of Leasehold Property to Freehold
summary: Legal transformation of 99-year municipal/housing board leased property into absolute private freehold ownership.
estimated_total_cost: Prescribed conversion fee based on plot size & circle rate

steps.title: Clear annual ground rent arrears
steps.description: Obtain no-dues receipt for ground rent and municipal service maintenance charges.

steps.title: Submit application with chain of title
steps.description: Upload original lease deed, all GPA/agreement chain documents, and architectural compliance affidavit.

steps.title: Building violation inspection
steps.description: Junior engineer inspects site to confirm absence of unapproved additional floors or misuse of residential premises.

steps.title: Demand note payment
steps.description: Estate office generates conversion demand notice; pay through RTGS or demand draft.

steps.title: Execution of Freehold Conveyance Deed
steps.description: Sign and register Conveyance Deed before Sub-Registrar, granting permanent absolute ownership.
